said on Friday that it received a
notice for failing to timely file its quarterly Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
The company has until Nov. 23, 2026, to submit a plan to regain compliance.
If accepted, Nasdaq could give the company until March 22, 2027, to complete the filing and regain compliance.
The company said it is working to file the report as soon as possible, but failure to meet the requirements could put its Nasdaq listing at risk.

title: Future Money Acquisition faces Nasdaq notice over delayed 10-Q filing
